findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation = true), so the same cryptographic material protects the audit bucket indefinitely; a compromised or leaked key version remains valid and cannot be retired on a routine schedule.

No aws_kms_key_policy is defined for this key, so AWS applies the default policy granting full kms:* permissions to the entire account root principal (all IAM principals in the account). Any principal with an attacker-controlled or over-broad policy can administer or use the audit-trail key, violating least privilege for encryption of audit data.
